name: David Phillip Donahue
office: City of Burbank, Member of the City Council

items.text: David Donahue is the founder of TrueVantage Homes. He says he co-founded and served as president of Burbank Fair Housing, now called “Don’t LA My Burbank,” and was also president of Vision Burbank. At a League of Women Voters forum, he supported a tax measure and called police surveillance cameras cost-effective, but said alternatives should be considered if hacking problems persist. He opposes a plan to remove traffic lanes on Olive Avenue for a Metro bus route, saying it would slow traffic, and has raised concerns about state housing law SB 79. His campaign lists priorities of local business, the economy, transportation, housing and infrastructure.
